item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: WATCH- Hardik Pandya’s heartfelt interaction with MS Dhoni and son Agastya
item.description: Hardik Pandya starred with both the bat and the ball as India defeated England by 7 runs in a high-scoring thriller in the second semifinal of the T20 World Cup 2026 at the Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai on March 5. Pandya first scored 27 runs in 12 balls with 3 fours and 2 sixes with the bat and then took the wicket of Phil Salt and bowled an extremely economic over in the death overs when Jacob Bethell was going after leather. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Sanju Samson features in ICC's list of nominees for Player of the Tournament
item.description: Sanju Samson has been included in the ICC's nominees for the Player of the Tournament award in the ongoing T20 World Cup 2026. The wicketkeeper-batter from India, who was not in the starting lineup at the start of the season, has now made his way onto the ICC shortlist. Considering that Samson has only participated in four games of the competition thus far, his ascent in the race is very impressive. However, the right-hander has amassed 232 runs at an average of 77.33 and a strike rate of 201.73

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “He is allowed to have a bad day,” Glenn Phillips downplays Jasprit Bumrah threat ahead of title clash
item.description: Jasprit Bumrah has been India’s real impact bowler in the ongoing T20 World Cup. item.title: ICC announces match officials for T20 World 2026 final between India and New Zealand
